title: CrowdSec
subtitle: CrowdSec LAPI adapter. Aegis emits decisions in CrowdSec wire format so any bouncer — nginx, HAProxy, Cloudflare Worker, firewall, or k8s ingress — can enforce them.
restart.title: Restart required.
restart.body: One or more settings were saved. Apply with the Restart button in the panel (rolling worker restart, no downtime).
lapi.title: LAPI URL
lapi.description: Base URL of your CrowdSec LAPI instance, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080. A service restart is required after saving.
bouncer.title: Bouncer key
bouncer.description: API key issued by cscli bouncers add aegis. Write-only — the stored value is never echoed back.
about.title: About the integration
about.p1: Aegis has 300k+ community detections from SigmaHQ plus its own ML-driven scoring. CrowdSec has 100k+ active community blocklist contributors and an entire bouncer ecosystem. The format adapter lets Aegis play in both worlds.
about.p2.suffix: for the wire format translator. Future work: bidirectional sync (Aegis → CrowdSec push + CrowdSec → Aegis pull for community CTI).
toast.saved.title: Saved — restart required
toast.saved.description: Setting saved. Restart Aegis workers to apply.
toast.saveFailed.title: Failed to save
